title: Lookalike Audiences
objectives: Explain how Meta's machine learning finds Lookalike audiences
Understand the critical importance of seed quality over seed quantity
Know when to use a 1% Lookalike versus 3% or 5%

blocks.text: What if you could clone your best paying customers? That is exactly what Lookalikes do!
A Lookalike Audience takes a source list of your top customers (called the 'seed') and finds the top 1% to 10% of people in a country who share their exact traits.

blocks.title: The Detective Analogy
blocks.text: Imagine giving a detective the fingerprints of your best 500 customers. The detective searches the country to find people with the identical behavioral fingerprint!

left.title: 1% Lookalike
points: Closest match to your seed list
Smaller audience pool (~3M to 4M in India)

right.title: 5% to 10% Lookalike
points: Much larger audience pool (15M-30M) for scaling

blocks.text: Garbage in, garbage out! A seed list of 300 repeat buyers will generate 10x better leads than a seed list of 5,000 free contest entrants.
Never create a Lookalike from low-intent actions like random Instagram link clicks. Use Purchases or verified high-quality Leads.

quiz.q: Which Lookalike audience percentage represents users who are most statistically similar to your seed customers?
quiz.explain: 1% contains the top 1% of users in the target country who most closely resemble your seed list.

quiz.q: Which of the following makes the HIGHEST quality seed list for an e-commerce store?
options: 10,000 people who entered a free Diwali giveaway
500 customers who made repeat purchases with order value > ₹2,000
Everyone who liked a meme on your Facebook page
All visitors who bounced within 3 seconds
quiz.explain: High-intent repeat buyers provide the clearest buying signals for Meta's algorithm to replicate.

quiz.q: True or False: A 10% Lookalike audience in India is larger in total reach than a 1% Lookalike audience.
quiz.explain: True. A 10% Lookalike covers 10% of Meta's total active user population in India.

quiz.q: What is the recommended minimum number of verified customer records in a seed list?
quiz.explain: Meta recommends at least 100 to 1,000 high-intent customer records to identify reliable behavioral patterns.

recap: Lookalikes find cold users who statistically match your best existing customers.
Seed quality beats quantity: 1% Lookalike gives maximum similarity; 3-5% allows broad scale.
